findings.title: Call to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() does not compile
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the only method added to its superclass UsernamePasswordForm is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user). There is no no-arg overload in UsernamePasswordForm or any other superclass, so this file will fail compilation and the whole change cannot build. The call should be e.g. isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()).

findings.title: Passkey conditional UI is no longer set up for anonymous (initial) login
findings.body: authenticate() now only calls webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context) when isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()) is true, and that helper requires user != null. On the initial login page no user has been identified yet, so context.getUser() is null, fillContextForm() is never called, and no WebAuthn challenge/RP/conditional-UI attributes are put on the login form. This inverts the previous behaviour (fill when passkeys are enabled and the user is not already selected) and breaks discoverable/passwordless passkey login from the first page, which existing tests such as webauthnLoginWithDiscoverableKey rely on. The same inverted condition at line 137 in challenge(context, error, field) also drops passkey data from error challenges shown to anonymous users after a failed attempt once the user is cleared.
